record.chaining: RUB 2,000 of VM-only bonus at the Russian CPU rate is a few weeks of a 2-vCPU box, and the RUB 3,000 half cannot be spent on the VM, so the effective VM credit is 40 per cent of the headline.

record.notes: The useful number here is not the RUB 5,000 but the split: 40 per cent of the individual bonus reaches virtual machines. The startup grant is the large figure (up to RUB 2,000,000, with RUB 500,000 for months one and two and up to RUB 1,500,000 for months three to six) and it is entity-gated, so it is fails-identity with the number beside the reason. The IP-in-Russia condition is the constraint no identity document satisfies, which is unusual: most Russian providers gate on the phone, this one gates on the network.
